edits.old: Then the system refuses the load with MSG-GEN-001 for assignment method on row 3
edits.new:
Then the system refuses the load with MSG-GEN-001 for assignment method on row 3

  Scenario: AC13 Role without Reference data C refused (exception X10)
    Given the loader holds RW-CASEOWN without Reference data C
    When the loader calls POST /admin/reference-loads with the QUEUE sheet
    Then the system refuses the call with 403 and MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC14 Contract silent for 2 s (exception X11)
    Given the rwb-access contract does not answer within 2 s
    When the QUEUE sheet is loaded
    Then the system refuses the load with 503 and MSG-P4-002
    Then nothing is written
    Then no role answer is taken from cache past its time-to-live

  Scenario: AC15 Member replace fails after the queue applies (exception X12)
    Given QUEUE version 2 is in force and version 3 is approved
    When the queue applies and the member replace fails
    Then the whole apply rolls back
    Then the previous version stays in force

  Scenario: AC16 Assignment method outside LOV-ASSIGN (BR7)
    Given queue row 5 has assignment method "RANDOM"
    When the QUEUE sheet is loaded
    Then the system refuses the load in full naming row 5 with message Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P3-E1019-APP-4)
